notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement -> owning files:
  - Window title (0): game/main.gd (sets OS window title).
  - Paddle movement, edge clamping, prints (1,2,13,14): game/paddle.gd (movement, velocity, prints).
  - Ball physics, wall rebounds, paddle bounce, spin, stop, signals (3,4,5,6,11): game/ball.gd (movement, collisions, signals).
  - Score, HUD, game over, restart, quit, input mapping and main scene orchestration (6,7,8,9,10,12,15,16,17,18): game/main.gd (score counter, labels, restart/quit handling, InputMap setup).
  - Scenes: game/main.tscn, game/paddle.tscn, game/ball.tscn hold Node2D roots with attached scripts that implement visuals via draw calls.

- State ownership and interfaces:
  - Main (game/main.gd): owns score:int, game_state:String ("running"/"gameover"), HUD nodes, creates and replaces paddle and ball. Methods:
    - func _on_ball_bounced() -> void
    - func _on_ball_missed() -> void
    - func restart_game() -> void
  - Paddle (game/paddle.gd): owns position:Vector2, size(Vector2), velocity:Vector2, screen_size:Vector2 (set by main). Methods:
    - func squash() -> void (async squash animation)
  - Ball (game/ball.gd): owns position, velocity, radius:float, speed:float, active:bool, screen_size:Vector2 (set by main), paddle:Node (set by main). Signals:
    - signal bounced
    - signal missed
    Methods:
    - func stop() -> void
    - func reset(pos:Vector2) -> void

- Input -> action -> state/rules -> feedback:
  - Inputs configured in main._ready(): "move_left","move_right","restart","quit".
  - Paddle handles movement on _physics_process, prints "MOVE LEFT"/"MOVE RIGHT" on just-pressed, clamps to screen edges (prevents leaving).
  - Ball moves each _physics_process and bounces off left/right/top walls; on paddle collision emits "bounced" (main increments score and prints nothing extra), ball picks spin from paddle.velocity.x, paddle.squash() called.
  - If ball falls below screen, ball emits "missed" (main sets game over, prints "GAME OVER", shows HUD, and calls ball.stop()).
  - Restart (R) prints "RESTART", re-instantiates paddle and ball, score set to 0.
  - Quit (Escape) prints "QUIT" and exits.

- Coordinate convention:
  - Node2D coordinates use top-left origin (0,0) top-left of window; paddle position references its center. Paddle draws rectangle centered on its position. Ball position is center.

- Lifecycle: init(_ready) -> running (ball active) -> on missed => gameover (ball stopped, HUD shown) -> restart resets all state and nodes -> quit exits.

Now I'll write the initial files: __init__.py, project.godot, main.tscn, main.gd. Then run syntax check.

+extends Node2D
+
+class_name Paddle
+
+@export var size:Vector2 = Vector2(120,18)
+@export var speed:float = 480.0
+var velocity:Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+var screen_size:Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    set_process(false)
+    set_physics_process(true)
+    queue_redraw()
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+    var rect = Rect2(-size/2, size)
+    draw_rect(rect, Color(0.2,0.6,0.9))
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    var new_vx:float = 0.0
+    if Input.is_action_pressed("move_left"):
+        new_vx -= speed
+        if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_left"):
+            print("MOVE LEFT")
+    if Input.is_action_pressed("move_right"):
+        new_vx += speed
+        if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_right"):
+            print("MOVE RIGHT")
+    velocity.x = new_vx
+    position.x += velocity.x * delta
+    # clamp to screen edges so paddle doesn't go off-screen
+    if screen_size != Vector2.ZERO:
+        var halfw:float = size.x/2
+        position.x = clamp(position.x, halfw, screen_size.x - halfw)
+    queue_redraw()
+
+func squash() -> void:
+    # quick squash visual: briefly change scale then return
+    scale = Vector2(1.05, 0.9)
+    queue_redraw()
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.08).timeout
+    scale = Vector2(1,1)
+    queue_redraw()

--- game/ball.gd
+++ game/ball.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+class_name Ball
+
+signal bounced
+signal missed
+
+@export var radius:float = 10.0
+@export var speed:float = 300.0
+var velocity:Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+var active:bool = true
+var screen_size:Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+var paddle:Node = null
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    set_physics_process(true)
+    queue_redraw()
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+    draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, radius, Color(0.9,0.2,0.2))
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if not active:
+        return
+    position += velocity * delta
+    # wall collisions
+    if screen_size != Vector2.ZERO:
+        # left wall
+        if position.x - radius < 0:
+            position.x = radius
+            velocity.x = abs(velocity.x)
+        # right wall
+        if position.x + radius > screen_size.x:
+            position.x = screen_size.x - radius
+            velocity.x = -abs(velocity.x)
+        # top wall
+        if position.y - radius < 0:
+            position.y = radius
+            velocity.y = abs(velocity.y)
+    # paddle collision
+    if paddle != null:
+        var paddle_pos:Vector2 = paddle.position
+        var paddle_size:Vector2 = paddle.size
+        var rect_min = paddle_pos - paddle_size/2
+        var rect_max = paddle_pos + paddle_size/2
+        # closest point on rect to circle center
+        var closest = Vector2(clamp(position.x, rect_min.x, rect_max.x), clamp(position.y, rect_min.y, rect_max.y))
+        var d = position.distance_to(closest)
+        if d <= radius and velocity.y > 0:
+            # collided from above
+            position.y = rect_min.y - radius
+            # invert y
+            velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y)
+            # add spin from paddle horizontal movement
+            var spin = 0.0
+            if "velocity" in paddle:
+                spin = paddle.velocity.x * 0.2
+            velocity.x += spin
+            # normalize to maintain speed
+            if velocity.length() == 0:
+                velocity = Vector2(0, -1) * speed
+            else:
+                velocity = velocity.normalized() * speed
+            emit_signal("bounced")
+            # call paddle squash if available
+            if "squash" in paddle:
+                paddle.squash()
+    # missed check: ball below paddle bottom
+    if paddle != null:
+        var paddle_bottom = paddle.position.y + paddle.size.y/2
+        if position.y - radius > paddle_bottom:
+            active = false
+            velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+            emit_signal("missed")
+    queue_redraw()
+
+func reset(pos:Vector2) -> void:
+    position = pos
+    active = true
+    # initial velocity mostly upwards
+    velocity = Vector2(0.5, -0.9).normalized() * speed
+    queue_redraw()
+
+func stop() -> void:
+    active = false
+    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+    queue_redraw()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
    if not active:
        return
    position += velocity * delta
    # wall collisions
    if screen_size != Vector2.ZERO:
        # left wall
        if position.x - radius < 0:
            position.x = radius
            velocity.x = abs(velocity.x)
        # right wall
        if position.x + radius > screen_size.x:
            position.x = screen_size.x - radius
            velocity.x = -abs(velocity.x)
        # top wall
        if position.y - radius < 0:
            position.y = radius
            velocity.y = abs(velocity.y)
    # paddle collision
    if paddle != null:
        var paddle_pos:Vector2 = paddle.position
        var paddle_size:Vector2 = paddle.size
        var rect_min = paddle_pos - paddle_size/2
        var rect_max = paddle_pos + paddle_size/2
        # closest point on rect to circle center
        var closest = Vector2(clamp(position.x, rect_min.x, rect_max.x), clamp(position.y, rect_min.y, rect_max.y))
        var d = position.distance_to(closest)
        if d <= radius and velocity.y > 0:
            # collided from above
            position.y = rect_min.y - radius
            # invert y
            velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y)
            # add spin from paddle horizontal movement
            var spin = 0.0
            if "velocity" in paddle:
                spin = paddle.velocity.x * 0.2
            velocity.x += spin
            # normalize to maintain speed
            if velocity.length() == 0:

            emit_signal("bounced")

    if paddle != null:
        var paddle_bottom = paddle.position.y + paddle.size.y/2

            emit_signal("missed")

    position = pos
    active = true
    # initial velocity mostly upwards
    velocity = Vector2(0.5, -0.9).normalized() * speed

@onready var gameover_label:Label = Label.new()

func _ready() -> void:
    # Window title
    OS.window_title = "Bounce Keeper"

    # Input setup
    if not InputMap.has_action("move_left"):
        InputMap.add_action("move_left")
    var ev = InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev)

    if not InputMap.has_action("move_right"):
        InputMap.add_action("move_right")
    ev = InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev)

    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
        InputMap.add_action("restart")
    ev = InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_R
    InputMap.action_add_event("restart", ev)

    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
        InputMap.add_action("quit")
    ev = InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
    InputMap.action_add_event("quit", ev)

    # HUD
    add_child(hud_layer)
    score_label.text = "Score: 0"
    score_label.position = Vector2(8,8)
    hud_layer.add_child(score_label)

    gameover_label.text = ""
    gameover_label.visible = false

    gameover_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(400,100)
    hud_layer.add_child(gameover_label)

    # determine screen size
    var vp = get_viewport()
    if vp != null:
        screen_size = vp.get_visible_rect().size
    if screen_size == Vector2.ZERO:
        # fallback to planned resolution
        screen_size = Vector2(800,600)

    # position gameover label in center
    gameover_label.position = Vector2(screen_size.x/2 - 200, screen_size.y/2 - 50)

    # spawn entities
    spawn_entities()

func spawn_entities() -> void:
    # remove old if present
    if paddle != null:
        if paddle.get_parent() == self:
            remove_child(paddle)
        paddle.queue_free()
        paddle = null
    if ball != null:
        if ball.get_parent() == self:
            remove_child(ball)
        ball.queue_free()
        ball = null

    paddle = PaddleScene.instantiate()
    paddle.position = Vector2(screen_size.x/2, screen_size.y - 60)
    if "screen_size" in paddle:
        paddle.screen_size = screen_size
    add_child(paddle)

    ball = BallScene.instantiate()
    ball.position = paddle.position - Vector2(0, 40)
    if "screen_size" in ball:
        ball.screen_size = screen_size
    if "paddle" in ball:
        ball.paddle = paddle
    add_child(ball)

    if ball.has_signal("bounced"):
        ball.connect("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced"))
    if ball.has_signal("missed"):

func _on_ball_bounced() -> void:
    score += 1
    update_score_label()

func _on_ball_missed() -> void:
    if game_state == "gameover":
        return
    game_state = "gameover"
    print("GAME OVER")
    gameover_label.text = "GAME OVER\nFinal Score: %d" % score

    if ball != null and ball.has_method("stop"):
        ball.stop()

func update_score_label() -> void:
    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score

func _input(event) -> void:
    # restart
    if event.is_action_pressed("restart") and event.is_pressed():
        if game_state == "gameover":
            print("RESTART")
            restart_game()
    # quit

        print("QUIT")

func restart_game() -> void:
    # re-create paddle and ball, reset score
    if paddle != null:
        if paddle.get_parent() == self:
            remove_child(paddle)
        paddle.queue_free()
        paddle = null
    if ball != null:
        if ball.get_parent() == self:
            remove_child(ball)
        ball.queue_free()

--- game/ball.gd

@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+class_name Ball
+
+signal bounced
+signal missed
+
+@export var radius:float = 10.0
+@export var speed:float = 300.0
+var velocity:Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+var active:bool = true
+var screen_size:Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+var paddle:Node = null
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    set_physics_process(true)
+    queue_redraw()
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+    draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, radius, Color(0.9,0.2,0.2))
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if not active:
+        return
+    position += velocity * delta
+    # wall collisions
+    if screen_size != Vector2.ZERO:
+        # left wall
+        if position.x - radius < 0:
+            position.x = radius
+            velocity.x = abs(velocity.x)
+        # right wall
+        if position.x + radius > screen_size.x:
+            position.x = screen_size.x - radius
+            velocity.x = -abs(velocity.x)
+        # top wall
+        if position.y - radius < 0:
+            position.y = radius
+            velocity.y = abs(velocity.y)
+    # paddle collision
+    if paddle != null:
+        var paddle_pos:Vector2 = paddle.position
+        var paddle_size:Vector2 = paddle.size
+        var rect_min = paddle_pos - paddle_size/2
+        var rect_max = paddle_pos + paddle_size/2
+        # closest point on rect to circle center
+        var closest = Vector2(clamp(position.x, rect_min.x, rect_max.x), clamp(position.y, rect_min.y, rect_max.y))
+        var d = position.distance_to(closest)
+        if d <= radius and velocity.y > 0:
+            # collided from above
+            position.y = rect_min.y - radius
+            # invert y
+            velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y)
+            # add spin from paddle horizontal movement
+            var spin = 0.0
+            if "velocity" in paddle:
+                spin = paddle.velocity.x * 0.2
+            velocity.x += spin
+            # normalize to maintain speed
+            if velocity.length() == 0:
+                velocity = Vector2(0, -1) * speed
+            else:
+                velocity = velocity.normalized() * speed
+            emit_signal("bounced")
+            # call paddle squash if available
+            if "squash" in paddle:
+                paddle.squash()
+    # missed check: ball below paddle bottom
+    if paddle != null:
+        var paddle_bottom = paddle.position.y + paddle.size.y/2
+        if position.y - radius > paddle_bottom:
+            active = false
+            velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+            emit_signal("missed")
+    queue_redraw()
+
+func reset(pos:Vector2) -> void:
+    position = pos
+    active = true
+    # initial velocity mostly upwards
+    velocity = Vector2(0.5, -0.9).normalized() * speed
+    queue_redraw()
+
+func stop() -> void:
+    active = false
+    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+    queue_redraw()

+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Window title
+    OS.window_title = "Bounce Keeper"
+
+    # Input setup
+    if not InputMap.has_action("move_left"):
+        InputMap.add_action("move_left")
+    var ev = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("move_right"):
+        InputMap.add_action("move_right")
+    ev = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
+        InputMap.add_action("restart")
+    ev = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_R
+    InputMap.action_add_event("restart", ev)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
+        InputMap.add_action("quit")
+    ev = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
+    InputMap.action_add_event("quit", ev)
+
+    # HUD
+    add_child(hud_layer)
+    score_label.text = "Score: 0"
+    score_label.position = Vector2(8,8)
+    hud_layer.add_child(score_label)
+
+    gameover_label.text = ""
+    gameover_label.visible = false
+    # center the label
+    gameover_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(400,100)
+    hud_layer.add_child(gameover_label)
+
+    # determine screen size
+    var vp = get_viewport()
+    if vp != null:
+        screen_size = vp.get_visible_rect().size
+    if screen_size == Vector2.ZERO:
+        # fallback to planned resolution
+        screen_size = Vector2(800,600)
+
+    # position gameover label in center
+    gameover_label.position = Vector2(screen_size.x/2 - 200, screen_size.y/2 - 50)
+
+    # spawn entities
+    spawn_entities()
+
+func spawn_entities() -> void:
+    # remove old if present
+    if paddle != null:
+        if paddle.get_parent() == self:
+            remove_child(paddle)
+        paddle.queue_free()
+        paddle = null
+    if ball != null:
+        if ball.get_parent() == self:
+            remove_child(ball)
+        ball.queue_free()
+        ball = null
+
+    paddle = PaddleScene.instantiate()
+    paddle.position = Vector2(screen_size.x/2, screen_size.y - 60)
+    if "screen_size" in paddle:
+        paddle.screen_size = screen_size
+    add_child(paddle)
+
+    ball = BallScene.instantiate()
+    ball.position = paddle.position - Vector2(0, 40)
+    if "screen_size" in ball:
+        ball.screen_size = screen_size
+    if "paddle" in ball:
+        ball.paddle = paddle
+    add_child(ball)
+    # connect signals
+    if ball.has_signal("bounced"):
+        ball.connect("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced"))
+    if ball.has_signal("missed"):
+        ball.connect("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed"))
+    if ball.has_method("reset"):
+        ball.reset(ball.position)
+    score = 0
+    update_score_label()
+    gameover_label.visible = false
+    game_state = "running"
+
+func _on_ball_bounced() -> void:
+    score += 1
+    update_score_label()
+
+func _on_ball_missed() -> void:
+    if game_state == "gameover":
+        return
+    game_state = "gameover"
+    print("GAME OVER")
+    gameover_label.text = "GAME OVER\nFinal Score: %d" % score
+    gameover_label.visible = true

+            restart_game()
+    # quit

+
+func restart_game() -> void:
+    # re-create paddle and ball, reset score

+        if paddle.get_parent() == self:
+            remove_child(paddle)
+        paddle.queue_free()
+        paddle = null
+    if ball != null:

+            remove_child(ball)
+        ball.queue_free()
+        ball = null
+    spawn_entities()
+    score = 0
